method: Independent arithmetic expressions compared with calculation outputs. The published Appendix K example is recorded separately.

cases.name: Single-slope eaves roof catchment
cases.source_basis: Independent trigonometric evaluation of the stated area-factor equation.

cases.name: Steel roof design flow
cases.source_basis: 0.9 x area x intensity / 3600, with L/s and SI input units.

cases.name: Pervious runoff coefficient
cases.source_basis: 1.0 x (0.0133 x 44.4 - 0.233), with no soil adjustment.

cases.name: Mixed surface design flow
cases.source_basis: Sum of area-weighted coefficients multiplied by intensity / 3600.

cases.name: Rectangular Manning channel capacity
cases.source_basis: Rectangular area and wetted perimeter evaluated independently in SI units.

cases.name: Sag-pit inlet capacity
cases.source_basis: 1600 x blockage factor x free perimeter x ponding depth to power 1.5.
